en: A vintage, black-and-white image depicting a large group of soldiers marching with pack animals (possibly mules or horses) through a narrow European street lined with historic multi-story stone buildings. The street is busy and filled predominantly with military figures, suggesting a wartime or historical parade scene. There is an arched entryway and some decorated facades visible, with bystanders watching from the buildings.
